blurb: Guests enjoy private charters on yachts cruising Charleston Harbor with views of historic landmarks and wildlife. Swimming is allowed on cruises of three hours or more at designated safe locations. Boats have bathrooms (except the skiff), Bluetooth stereos, and coolers with ice; guests may bring their own food and drinks including alcohol.
extraNote: Full refund if canceled due to weather · 100% refund if canceled 30 days prior · Deposit kept if canceled 1 week to 30 days prior · No refund if canceled less than 1 week prior except for weather · No damage deposit required; customer responsible for damage repair costs · Captain makes final safety decision on day of charter · Ripley Light Yacht Club (except the skiff)

quotes.author: Vanessa Adams
quotes.text: Vanessa Adams 16:24 08 Jun 26 Perfect weather and perfect boat ride to spread ashes. Captain Dan always answered the phone with our questions and made sure we were the required distance out to honor the wishes of a loved one. Lily and Captain Dan were very respectful and allowed us to play music. It couldn’t have been a more perfect goodbye. Thanks for all of your help Captain Dan!

quotes.author: Isabela Venice
quotes.text: Isabela Venice 13:47 19 Oct 21 Absolutely amazing! We had a group of 12 for a Bach party, and had the best time. Our charter with Captain Dan and Cody was the highlight of the trip for everyone! Dan was super responsive, and made sure everything was clear ahead of time. The boat itself was spacious and had everything we needed! Not one complaint. Highly recommend this crew!

quotes.author: Kate Dockery
quotes.text: Kate Dockery 14:53 06 Jul 26 We had a great experience with Charleston Yacht Tours! The captains were very kind, responsive and professional. We had the best day and booked the wagon wheel for a 3 hour charter. It comfortably fit 17 people. 10/10 will use this service again and would recommend to locals and groups visiting!

quotes.author: Julie Eckelbarger
quotes.text: Julie Eckelbarger 23:49 15 Jan 23 Fantastic private boat tour for a birthday. Communication beforehand was excellent, calming my fears about cold weather, and helped me coordinate catering to the boat. Our captains were great, super Knowledgable about Charleston. Would absolutely do it again. All 13 of our party loved it.

quotes.author: Stephanie Orr
quotes.text: Stephanie Orr 02:13 04 Oct 22 We went during the early afternoon for my bachelorette party, and it was a fantastic time! Probably one of the top highlights of our weekend. Captains were super fun, friendly, and even shared some fun historical facts about Charleston. A must-do if you're visiting for the first time!

quotes.author: Lisa Daniels Twitty
quotes.text: Lisa Daniels Twitty 12:13 16 May 26 Capt Dan and the High Tide provided our small business group of 5 with a wonderful tour. The boat was spotless and well equipped with a cooler of ice and room for our catering which Capt Dan also helped us organize. We would def hire Capt Dan and his boat again.
